alt: A source grid next to a result grid. The visual first builds the horizontal reflection, each row reversed left to right, then clears and builds the vertical reflection, the row order reversed top to bottom.

steps.caption: The source is 2 rows by 3 columns. Reflecting horizontally reverses each row left to right; the shape stays the same.
old[0][0] = 'A' moves to new[0][2]: row 0 reverses left to right.
old[0][1] = 'B' moves to new[0][1]: row 0 reverses left to right.
old[0][2] = 'C' moves to new[0][0]: row 0 reverses left to right.
old[1][0] = 'D' moves to new[1][2]: row 1 reverses left to right.
old[1][1] = 'E' moves to new[1][1]: row 1 reverses left to right.
old[1][2] = 'F' moves to new[1][0]: row 1 reverses left to right.
The horizontal reflection is done. Every row now reads backward.
Now reflect the same source vertically: reverse the order of the rows top to bottom, leaving each row's own contents unchanged.
old[0][0] = 'A' moves to new[1][0]: row 0 becomes row 1.
old[0][1] = 'B' moves to new[1][1]: row 0 becomes row 1.
old[0][2] = 'C' moves to new[1][2]: row 0 becomes row 1.
old[1][0] = 'D' moves to new[0][0]: row 1 becomes row 0.
old[1][1] = 'E' moves to new[0][1]: row 1 becomes row 0.
old[1][2] = 'F' moves to new[0][2]: row 1 becomes row 0.
The vertical reflection is done. The rows are in reverse order; each row's own contents did not change.
The source is 1 rows by 3 columns. Reflecting horizontally reverses each row left to right; the shape stays the same.
old[0][0] = 'X' moves to new[0][2]: row 0 reverses left to right.
old[0][1] = 'Y' moves to new[0][1]: row 0 reverses left to right.
old[0][2] = 'Z' moves to new[0][0]: row 0 reverses left to right.
The horizontal reflection is done. Every row now reads backward.
Now reflect the same source vertically: reverse the order of the rows top to bottom, leaving each row's own contents unchanged.
old[0][0] = 'X' moves to new[0][0]: row 0 becomes row 0.
old[0][1] = 'Y' moves to new[0][1]: row 0 becomes row 0.
old[0][2] = 'Z' moves to new[0][2]: row 0 becomes row 0.
The vertical reflection is done. The rows are in reverse order; each row's own contents did not change.
